findings.text: `int(nth)` silently wraps for integer types wider than int or with values above MaxInt. For example, `Nth(s, uint64(math.MaxUint64))` becomes -1 and returns the last element instead of an out-of-bounds error. `uint64(1<<63)` becomes MinInt, where `-n` overflows, so the bounds check passes and `collection[l+n]` panics.
The out-of-bounds error now prints the converted `n` instead of the caller's `nth`. For a wrapped value such as `uint64(MaxUint64)` the message shows a different number from the one passed in.
